meaning:
κατα-μαρτυρέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Job.15:6, Pro.25:18 (עָנָה), al. ;]
to bear witness againt: with accusative of thing(s) and genitive of person(s), Mat.26:62 27:13, Mrk.14:60.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: The high priest stood up, and said to him, “Have you no answer? What is this that these testify against you?”
The high priest stood up in the middle, and asked Jesus, “Have you no answer? What is it which these testify against you?”
